description: Renovate configuration for camunda-stackit-connectors.
Commit subjects read `deps: update ...`. semanticCommits is disabled so that Renovate
does not additionally prepend a conventional-commit type of its own; commitMessagePrefix
then fully controls the subject prefix.
Dependency updates land in one weekly batch instead of trickling in: the full PR gate
runs Testcontainers integration tests, so every PR costs real runner minutes. Security
fixes are exempt - see vulnerabilityAlerts below.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule and the PR limits.

description: Pin GitHub Actions to an immutable commit digest. Renovate keeps the readable
major tag as a trailing comment, so `uses: actions/checkout@<sha> # v7` stays
both auditable and reviewable.
The Camunda Connector SDK is NOT independently versionable against the runtime:
the io.camunda.connector:* minor version must match the Camunda 8 runtime minor
version (8.10.x SDK <-> 8.10.x runtime). Mixing minors breaks element template
generation and the connector job worker protocol, so every io.camunda* artifact -
including element-template-generator-maven-plugin - has to move in a single PR.
MANUAL FOLLOW-UP IS ALWAYS REQUIRED on these PRs. Renovate only edits the version
properties in the root pom. A minor bump additionally needs:
1. <version.connectors> and <version.camunda> both on the matching minor,
2. the @ElementTemplate(engineVersion = "^8.x") ranges in the connector sources
updated to that minor,
3. './mvnw -DskipTests process-classes' re-run and the regenerated element
templates committed - the CI drift check fails otherwise,
4. the template 'version' bumped and a versioned/ snapshot archived if any
property changed.
Renovate cannot do steps 2-4. Never merge these PRs unattended.
prBodyNotes: :warning: **Manual follow-up required.** The Connector SDK minor version must match the Camunda runtime minor version. Verify `version.connectors` *and* `version.camunda`, update the `@ElementTemplate(engineVersion = ...)` ranges, then re-run `./mvnw -DskipTests process-classes` and commit the regenerated element templates.

packageRules.description: The AWS SDK v2 ships dozens of co-versioned artifacts; one PR per release train.
STACKIT SDK modules are released together against a shared core.
Test-only dependencies are low risk and noisy; batch them.

description: Build plugins move independently of the application dependencies. io.camunda* is
deliberately NOT matched here (element-template-generator-maven-plugin belongs to
the lockstep Camunda group above).
Maven 3.10.0 is mandatory (element-template-generator-maven-plugin requires it)
and is pinned by the committed Maven Wrapper. Wrapper upgrades are proposed but
never merged unattended: the enforcer rule, .mvn/jvm.config and the
distributionType=only-script setup must be re-checked against the new version.
